messages:
Laura M.: Quick heads-up — planning a 90min enablement sprint next Wed for two things: (1) dedicated migration hands-on lab for mid-market accounts migrating to Dedicated, and (2) pre-renewal health-check + playbook review for at-risk accounts. Need volunteers for leads and timezone-friendly slots.
Jin K.: +1. Proposed agenda:
```
- 0-10: welcome & goals
- 10-40: migration lab (walkthrough + exercises)
- 40-70: account health + renewal risk triage
- 70-90: action items & follow-ups
```
Marco P.: Can we split into EMEA/APAC-friendly runs? suggested slots: Wed 09:00 PDT / Wed 17:00 UTC / Thu 02:00 UTC. I'll run the EMEA slot if someone takes APAC.
Priya R.: I can host the APAC run. Also request: include a short checklist for data masking and logs access — customers keep pinging about PII handling.
Laura M.: Thanks — Priya handles APAC. Marco takes EMEA. Need a backend engineer for the migration lab to join live for debugging. @Alex T. can you cover the lab runway for one slot?
Alex T.: Yup I can do the Wed 09:00 PDT and the Wed 17:00 UTC slot. I'll prepare a small preconfigured repo + docker run snippet.
Jin K.: Prep ask for customers: 1) sample model & prompt set, 2) current latency/cost targets, 3) salt/keys readiness. I'll add a short survey — link below.
Marco P.: also recommend a mini pre-read: `migration-checklist.md` + known pitfalls. I'll drop it in the shared drive.
Laura M.: Draft agenda added to the shared doc: https://redwood.app/s/enablement-sprint-draft — plz review by EOD Tues. We'll also collect session feedback via this form: https://forms.redwood.co/enablement-feedback
Priya R.: FYI Acme asked to prioritize KV cache behavior and DEDICATED autoscaling examples.
Alex T.: I'll include a tiny demo of prefix caching and autoscale config: `redwoodctl scale --policy=burst --min=2 --max=8`
Laura M.: Good. For renewal-risk accounts we'll run a 15min triage per account during the session. Need volunteers to own post-session action items and outreach.
Jin K.: I'll own outreach for accounts flagged as 'at-risk' (renewal <60 days). Marco can collate health metrics dashboards.
Marco P.: Will export per-account token cost, error rates, and recent eval regressions into a one-pager.
calendar-bot: Tentative event created: "Enablement Sprint — Dedicated Migration + Renewal Health" Wed 09:00 PDT / 17:00 UTC — invites sent to: laura.m@redwood, jin.k@redwood, marco.p@redwood, priya.r@redwood, alex.t@redwood. Use /accept or /decline.
Priya R.: Accepted. Small ask from CS: can we have an actionable 1-pager to hand to CSMs after the session? That helps with renewal talks.
Laura M.: Yes — we'll produce a 1-pager + follow-up playbook. Plan: run two sessions next week (EMEA & APAC). If anyone has conflicts ping me and I'll re-slot. :thumbsup: 
Alex T.: I'll push the demo repo to `github.com/redwood/enablement-lab` by EOD Tues.
Jin K.: I'll send out the survey and an agenda update. Thanks everyone — excited to get these customers safer on Dedicated.
Laura M.: Wrap-up: volunteers = Priya (APAC lead), Marco (EMEA lead + metrics), Alex (lab engineer), Jin (agenda & outreach). Next check-in: Tue 16:00 PT. If not needed, we'll cancel. :calendar:
